Under the rewrite, approval must anchor to canonical execution-unit context first, with any tier/package/seam label only as secondary presentation metadata.
exact_items: - Because the older HITL contract is tier-keyed, it is still vulnerable to the same stale-ownership problem as `TierContext`. Under the rewrite, approval must anchor to canonical execution-unit context first, with any tier/package/seam label only as secondary presentation metadata.
